message.content:
Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a multicystic mass in the fetal right hemithorax (indicated by arrows) with visible systemic arterial supply on color Doppler, characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or CPAM. Such space-occupying lesions in the right lung typically cause mass effect, resulting in displacement of the heart to the contralateral (left) side and depression/elevation of the ipsilateral diaphragm.
